messages.subject: For Paal Eikeseth | Government relations, stakeholder strategy and energy services
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Norum,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Paal Eikeseth, President and Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

Aker Solutions operates across complex energy markets where project delivery, institutional relationships, local value and sustainability execution directly affect long-term performance. That environment closely matches my current executive responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across resource, infrastructure and energy matters.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of stakeholder leadership, emerging-market experience and cross-functional execution could support Aker Solutions internationally. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Aker Solutions.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
